_why: Frozen strategy parameters. signal_dual_momentum.py refuses to emit ledger records when its effective parameters do not match this file. The point is not to make change impossible -- it is to make change impossible to do QUIETLY. Editing this file shows up in a git diff with a human name on it; re-fitting after a losing quarter does not get to look like a normal run. See reference/STRATEGY.md: parameters are not to be re-fit on the realised sample, because that is how a dead strategy becomes an overfitted one.
_reason: Revised from a DAILY basis (252/21/200) to MONTHLY (12/1/10). Not a re-fit: no result was tuned toward, and the change was made before the strategy traded a single live signal. The daily parameterisation was never backtested; the monthly one was measured over 235 months (see reference/STRATEGY.md). Running live on parameters nobody tested, while holding a validated set on the shelf, is the mistake this lock exists to prevent -- so the untested set was the one to go.
_universe_note: EEM removed 2026-09-11: its price series splices two differently-adjusted segments (2007-12 at 16.70, 2008-01 at 45.63). Quarantined in history/QUARANTINE_eem.json, not repaired -- the true split ratio and date are not known with confidence and a guessed factor would yield prices that look real. Restore to the universe only after the series is re-pulled and verified.
